title: Playing with Sam Morgan, Kid Clayton and Clarence Desdunes's band
summary: Working in New Orleans at 17-18, he lists the fourteen-piece Desdunes band and its tour of the Midwest.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, I worked in New Orleans when I was around 17 and 18 years old.
Did you play with bands or piano?
Well, I played some with Sam Morgan's band. And also I played some with Kid Clayton. He's a trumpet player.
Oh, yeah.
He's still there.
Yeah. Yeah, he's still playing. Doing quite well. Um... You once made a tour, didn't you, with Desdune?
Yeah, well I played with Clance Desdune's band. He was out in New Orleans. Yeah.
Did you play with him in the city too? Oh, yeah.
We played at Pelican, Estor, and then out. Out of town. Yeah.
Who else was in that band that you remember? He played trombone, didn't he?
Oh, he played violin.
Violin? Oh, I thought he was a trombone player. No, no.
He played violin. I see. Let me see who all were in the band. Me and Raymond Johnson.
What did he play?
Raymond Johnson played trombone.
Trombone.
Raymond Brown, that was it. Oh, Raymond Brown. Raymond Brown, he played trombone. And Harry Faganatou played banjo.
What's that name again?
Harry Faganatou. He had a French name.
Yeah, there was French names, didn't there? Yeah.
And Oliver Alcon. Oh, yeah. Alvin Alcon. Well, George McCullin were first, and then Alvin taking his place.
Oh, yeah.

Alvin Alcon, George, and Shine, the drummer they call Shine. Oh, yes. He was playing drums with us. And Pop Kimball, he was a bass, tuba player. Yes. Let's see. Hal Desjohn, he was a saxophone player. Oh, yes. He's still there. And Lucian Johnson was a saxophone player. They had a reed session.
Big band then, wasn't it?
Yeah. Fourteen pieces.

About what date was that? I mean, or what years? How old were you when you were with Desden? Well, that was around 1928. When did you leave on tour with him? Right away then, after that? Well, I left after then with him.

We toured all through Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Illinois, Illinois, Iowa, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Michigan. And we made, we played Oklahoma also. Played a few dates over in Dakota, South Dakota, across from Sioux City, Iowa.
